name: 3D models (OpenSCAD)
description: Design parametric 3D models in OpenSCAD (text in, STL out) and check they will print. Check compiles the model and reports errors and warnings as file(line), and whether it is a valid solid; Export STL, 3MF and PNG make the outputs; Mesh info analyses any STL in plain arithmetic (triangles, size in mm, volume, surface area, whether it is watertight); Will it print checks the model against your printer bed (bed=220x220x250), watertightness, thin parts and how much overhangs; Parameters lists the numbers the model is built from; New part starts a parametric box. SAFETY: OpenSCAD can read any file the account can (include, import, surface), so every run happens inside bubblewrap: no network, no home folder, a read-only system, only a scratch copy of the model's folder writable; without bwrap the tool refuses to run OpenSCAD. The original is never changed.

presets.label: Check (errors, warnings, valid solid)
presets.description: Compiles the model in a sandbox: syntax errors and warnings as file(line), whether a solid was made and whether it is a simple (2-manifold) solid that a slicer accepts.

presets.label: Export STL
presets.description: The model as an STL mesh for a slicer.

presets.label: Export 3MF
presets.description: The model as a 3MF file (units and colours kept, smaller than STL).

presets.label: Picture of the model (PNG)
presets.description: A rendered picture of the model, made without a screen.

presets.label: Mesh info (STL or model)
presets.description: Triangles, vertices, bounding box in mm, volume, surface area, and whether the mesh is watertight, for an .stl or a .scad (compiled first).

presets.label: Will it print? (bed, watertight, overhangs)
presets.description: Checks an .stl or .scad against a printer bed (type bed=220x220x250 in the extra arguments; default 220x220x250 mm): does it fit (and would it if turned), is it watertight, is any part thinner than 0.8 mm, how much overhangs more than 45 degrees. Arithmetic on the mesh, not a slicer.

presets.label: Parameters of the model
presets.description: The top-level numbers the model is built from, with their group (from /* [Group] */ comments), value and comment: what to change to resize it.

presets.label: New part (parametric box)
presets.description: Creates NAME.scad in the folder you give: a rounded box with a wall thickness, every size a parameter at the top. Type the name in the extra arguments. Never overwrites.
